nodes.label: card-back.svg (shipped card reverse)
nodes.rationale: The shipped reverse, loaded through by MembershipCardBack.tsx. Byte-for-byte identical to the design export (same 1,191,979 bytes, same MD5 70fdf21547332af8be8352a817e10f3a) — the supplied artwork used unchanged, in contrast to the face, which needed two edits. Because an SVG loaded through cannot receive per-member React content, the live QR symbol is laid over the artwork's own white well rather than drawn into the file.

nodes.label: QR Well
nodes.source_location: fill="#ffffff" rounded region on the reverse
nodes.rationale: A rounded white panel drawn into the back artwork itself, reserved for the membership QR symbol. Because the artwork is loaded through it cannot receive per-member content, so the live code is laid over this well as a second SVG layer — both layers stay vector, so the card is sharp at every size. The well is padded by 4/45 on each side to reserve the four-module quiet zone scanners need around the 37 live modules of a level-M code.

edges.source_location: the only #ffffff fills in an otherwise charcoal-and-gold file
same pattern on the reverse: artwork reserves the space, the per-member layer is drawn over it because an -loaded SVG takes no dynamic content
